description: The same eloquence, for one night more

participation.context: Wrote the page and did not correct the king yet.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Has not seen the page, and was not shown it.
participation.name: Will Kemp

story.body: You wrote that you had caught the one eloquence and would not pretty it tonight. You kept Kemp off the page. You did not answer Anne with a new sentence.
topics: the page Kemp has not seen

title: Left the uncles as fine as the king, for one night
